headline: Diversified portfolio cushions profit as core ag softens
summary_short: Deere reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $13.092B (+8.9% y/y) and net income of $1.773B, with diluted EPS of $6.55, as growth in Small Ag & Turf and Construction & Forestry offset a steep decline in Production & Precision Ag.
summary_long: Revenue rose 8.9% y/y to $13.092B, though segment mix shifted sharply: Production & Precision Ag net sales fell 14% on lower shipment volumes (operating margin 15.7% vs 22.0%), while Small Ag & Turf (+16% sales, +25% profit) and Construction & Forestry (+29% sales, +48% profit) gained on higher volumes and favorable price realization. Operating income and EBITDA both declined y/y per shard data even as net income and diluted EPS ($6.55) rose, a divergence flagged in confidence notes. Financial Services net income grew 18% on favorable financing spreads. The company maintained its FY2026 net income guidance of $4.5-5.0 billion. Cash and equivalents were $7.905B at quarter-end, down from $8.276B at fiscal year-end.
